name: Smart Site Health Monitor
author: meetupadhyay

sections.description:
Smart Site Health Monitor gives you a clear, real-time health score for your WordPress site. It scans for plugin conflicts, outdated software, database bloat, and PHP issues — then lets you fix them all with one click.

Key Features

  • Health Score (0–100) calculated from all checks
  • Plugin conflict detection
  • Outdated plugin warnings
  • PHP health checks (version, memory, debug mode)
  • Database health panel
  • One-Click Cleanup — counts update live after each fix, no page reload
  • Dashboard widget showing score at a glance
  • Admin notice for critical scores

One-Click Cleanup

Fix database issues instantly with live feedback:

  • Delete post revisions — count shows 0 immediately after deleting
  • Delete spam comments — updates live
  • Clear expired transients — updates live
  • Optimize database tables — shows overhead removed
  • Empty trash permanently — updates live
  • Delete orphaned post meta — updates live

Each card shows the current count in real time. After you click a fix button the count updates immediately — you always know exactly what was cleaned.

Privacy

This plugin does not collect or send any data to external servers. All scans run locally on your server.
sections.installation:
1. Upload or install from WordPress plugin directory
  2. Activate the plugin
  3. Go to Site Health in your admin menu
  4. Click Scan Now
sections.faq:
How does the live count update work?

After you click any cleanup button, the plugin runs the fix and immediately fetches fresh counts from your database. The count on each card updates in real time — no page reload needed. A green success message appears on the card showing exactly how many items were deleted.

Does this plugin fix issues automatically?

It identifies issues and gives you one-click buttons to fix database issues. Plugin conflicts and PHP issues require manual action (updating plugins, changing PHP settings).
